name: NSF I-Corps New England Region Hub

description.text: Discover the New England NSF I‑Corps Hub- helping researchers accelerate the commercialization of new technologies through entrepreneurial training, support, and funding opportunities - a partnership of MIT, Brown, Harvard, Northeastern, Tufts, UMaine, UMass Amherst and UNH.

sources.quote: New England I‑Corps Hub | Innovation and Entrepreneurial Training Founders’ Stories About Programs Course Calendar Get Involved Hub News Apply Now Accelerating New England Research to Market Founders’ Stories Researchers with New Technologies NE I-Corps + VMS: Non-dilutive Funding for Deep Tech: SBIR, STTR and TTP Explained See materials and recording Explore the potential impact of your new technology Learn how to assess the market opportunity and pathway for your invention Get entrepreneurial training, support, and up to $50,000 for customer discovery Strengthen your SBIR/STTR proposal if pursuing a startup NSF I-Corps Hub: New England Region What The National Science Foundation’s (NSF) Innovation Corps, or I-Corps , is a program that prepares scientists and engineers to extend their focus beyond the laboratory to accelerate the transfer of cutting-edge research into commercial success. Learn More Who Whether you are just curious about the innovation process or certain you want to create a startup, I-Corps provides research faculty, staff, and students and prospective technology entrepreneurs with the ideal entry point. Learn More Why Understand why your technology has value, and to whom, while gaining an appreciation for what it takes to commercialize technology and the barriers to adoption. Develop a network of like-minded peers, instructors, investors, and mentors. Learn
